# Numerical fixture provenance

Generated by `scripts/generate_small_baselines.R` with seed 2026 and five
updates, from the read-only reference commit
87b4f898bd0a5167a987cdea95db9651d42d1e28. Generator inputs and exact outputs
are stored together in each JSON file. These are synthetic test inputs.
R 4.5.1, RcppArmadillo 15.6.2-1, CPU double precision, one requested thread.

The fixtures cover both binary inference paths and the other five models.
Dynamic fixtures include partial tenures; Poisson fixtures include multiple
documents per subject. Hierarchical covariance cubes are serialized with the
group/item index first. Tests compare all exported parameter and variance fields.

`hierarchical_real.json` additionally contains 2,000 observations sampled from
the supplied dwnom real dataset using R seed 314. Subject, item and group indices
are compactly remapped while preserving starts and priors. It is generated by
`scripts/generate_real_hierarchical_fixture.R` and checks five updates.

## Logistic mirt fixture

`logistic_mirt.json` was exported by `scripts/export_logistic_mirt.R` from
mirt 1.48.5, commit `211851adae7a6bee580af830d37187f0e81a5ca8`, with R 4.5.1.
It records the source version, quadrature, inputs, fitted item parameters,
probability curves, EAP scores and conditional posterior variances. Synthetic
inputs are generated by `scripts/prepare_logistic_mirt.py`; LSAT7 is mirt's
bundled real response-frequency table. All fits fix N(0,1) and use no item
priors. Regenerate and review using the instructions in `VALIDATION.md`.
The fixture supports exact fixed-parameter checks for all five configurations;
independent fitted-parameter parity is tested only for Rasch, 1PL and 2PL.
The observed 3PL/4PL optimization discrepancies are documented in `VALIDATION.md`.

## Multidimensional mirt fixture

`multidimensional_mirt.json` is generated by
`scripts/prepare_multidimensional_reference.py`,
`scripts/export_multidimensional_reference.R` and
`scripts/check_multidimensional_reference.py`. It uses mirt 1.48.5, commit
`211851adae7a6bee580af830d37187f0e81a5ca8`, R 4.5.1, fixed N(0,I), no item priors,
and 15-point-per-factor Gauss–Hermite integration. It contains deterministic
synthetic pattern counts and R outputs for confirmatory/exploratory 2D,
bifactor and testlet calibrations. Specialized bfactor predictions are evaluated
at fixed JAX parameters; all independently fitted reference parameters come
from the full-dimensional mirt engine. See `VALIDATION.md` for settings and
scoring-coordinate handling. The fixture is a regression baseline, not a
runtime report; generated diagnostics remain in ignored outputs/.

## Polytomous mirt fixture

`polytomous_mirt.json` is generated by the prepare/export/check polytomous
reference scripts. R mirt 1.48.5, source commit
`211851adae7a6bee580af830d37187f0e81a5ca8`, R 4.5.1, supplies independent GRM,
PCM, GPCM and RSM fits with fixed N(0,1) and no item priors. Synthetic frequencies
are generated using independent SciPy formulas. Inputs and expected category
probabilities, item parameters, EAP scores and variances are stored together.
See `VALIDATION.md` for the exact parameter mapping and reproduction commands.

## Nominal/nested mirt fixture

`nominal_mirt.json` is generated by the prepare/export/check nominal reference
scripts using R mirt 1.48.5, commit `211851adae7a6bee580af830d37187f0e81a5ca8`,
R 4.5.1. It includes synthetic response-pattern frequencies and independent R
fits for nominal and nested 2PL/3PL/3PLu/4PL, with matched N(0,1), no item priors
and 41-point quadrature. `VALIDATION.md` records parameter mappings, optimizer
settings and the distinction between kernel agreement and fitted-parameter
agreement. Generated diagnostics remain ignored in outputs/nominal/.

## Noncompensatory/sequential mirt fixture

`response_mirt.json` is generated by the prepare/export/check response reference
scripts. It stores independent SciPy synthetic pattern frequencies and R mirt
1.48.5 outputs (source commit `211851adae7a6bee580af830d37187f0e81a5ca8`,
R 4.5.1) for PC1PL/PC2PL/PC3PL and sequential/Tutz. Priors, parameter mappings,
quadrature and optimizer settings are recorded in `VALIDATION.md`. It is a
regression baseline with inputs and expected outputs; generated comparison
reports remain ignored under outputs/response-models/.

## GGUM mirt fixture

`ggum_mirt.json` is generated by the prepare/export/check GGUM reference scripts
using R mirt 1.48.5, source commit `211851adae7a6bee580af830d37187f0e81a5ca8`,
R 4.5.1. It stores independent NumPy synthetic frequencies and R fits for binary
and mixed-category unidimensional GGUM, including starting values, quadrature,
parameters, conditional curves, likelihood and EAP moments. Threshold sign,
order constraints and optimizer settings are documented in `VALIDATION.md`.
It is a regression baseline, not a runtime report; generated comparison reports
remain ignored in outputs/ggum/.
